title: UserConsentResponse
description: User consent information for OAuth 2.0 client

clientId.description: Unique identifier for the client application

clientName.description: Human-readable name of the client application

clientUri.description: URL of the client application's home page

logoUri.description: URL of the client application's logo image

policyUri.description: URL of the client application's privacy policy

requested_scopes.description: List of OAuth 2.0 scopes being requested by the client

consented_scopes.description: List of OAuth 2.0 scopes the user has already consented to

subject.description: User identifier (subject) associated with the consent
